App.name: Digital Hiring
App.tagline: Verified workers. Protected wages. Zero hassle.

Landing.title: Find Workers. Find Work.
Landing.description: Rozgaar connects employers with rated, verified daily-wage professionals across Pakistan — post a job in under a minute and let AI do the matching.
Landing.needWorkerDesc: Post a job in under a minute. Our AI finds rated professionals near you and sends your offer straight to them.
Landing.amWorkerDesc: Offers come to you based on your skills and city. Your wage is secured in escrow before you even start.
Landing.featureVerifiedDesc: Every account verifies its phone with OTP. Ratings and escrow keep both sides honest.
Landing.featureMatchingDesc: Tell us the job once — our matching engine finds the best-rated workers within 50 km and sends them your offer.
Landing.featurePaymentDesc: Wages sit in escrow from the moment a worker accepts until the job is done. Released only when everyone agrees.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Welcome to Digital Hiring App. By using our services, you agree to the following terms.
Terms.accountText: Your account data is used for app operation, matching, and notifications. We may contact you regarding app issues and important updates.
Terms.blockingText: Accounts may be suspended for violating these terms, fraudulent activity, or misuse. Suspended users cannot login or use the app.
Terms.jobDeletionText: Employers may delete jobs only while no worker has accepted. Once a worker accepts, the job cannot be deleted.
Terms.paymentText: All payment/escrow features are simulated. No real money is transferred. Payment status indicators show the simulated state only.
Terms.feedbackText: Both parties should submit honest feedback after job completion. Ratings affect worker visibility. Abusive or fraudulent feedback may result in account suspension.
Terms.locationText: Location data is used for matching workers with nearby jobs. Exact coordinates are kept private and not shared with other users.
Terms.privacyText: Phone numbers are shared only after both parties agree to a job. Personal information is protected and not shared with third parties.
Terms.contactText: By using this app, you agree to receive notifications about jobs, offers, and app updates. You may be contacted regarding reported issues.
